after_snippet:
# In pytest 9.0.0, duplicate paths are automatically removed

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmp = Path(tmpdir)
    (tmp / "test_file.py").write_text("def test_x(): pass")
    
    # In 9.0.0, passing the same file twice only runs it once
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "--collect-only", "-q", "test_file.py", "test_file.py"],
        cwd=tmp,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    # Now only 1 test is collected
    assert "1 test" in result.stdout
    
    # To preserve the old behavior, use --keep-duplicates
    result2 = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "--collect-only", "-q", "--keep-duplicates", "test_file.py", "test_file.py"],
        cwd=tmp,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    assert result2.returncode == 0

# In pytest 8.4.2, pytest x.py x.py would execute the same file twice
# In 9.0.0, duplicates are removed by default

import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmp = Path(tmpdir)
    (tmp / "test_file.py").write_text("def test_x(): pass")
    
    # In 8.4.2, explicitly passing the same file twice would run it twice
    result = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "--collect-only", "-q", "test_file.py", "test_file.py"],
        cwd=tmp,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True
    )
    # In 8.4.2 this would show 2 tests collected
    assert "2 test" in result.stdout
title: Running same test file twice no longer executes it twice
